newsitem.title: CHINA: China plans annual inspection of foreign firms.
newsitem.headline: China plans annual inspection of foreign firms.

text.p: Chinese financial authorities will hold joint yearly inspections of foreign-funded companies to try to simplify examination procedures, the Xinhua news agency said.

The Leading Group for Foreign Investment under the State Council, or cabinet, would direct examinations of foreign-funded firms, focusing on capital, foreign exchange, foreign trade and management, Xinhua said in a report late on Tuesday.
The inspections were aimed at cutting the number and variety of annual forms foreign companies were required to fill out each year, the agency said.
Enterprises would be required to provide data to the inspection teams, it said without elaborating.
The Leading Group had banned the levying of any new fees for the inspections and had ordered inspectors to tighten controls to ensure accuracy in the reports, it said.

The inspections would be carried out by seven government agencies including the Ministry of Foreign Trade, the Ministry of Finance, the State Administration for Industry and Commerce and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, it said.
The General Administration of Customs, the State Taxation Administration and the State Economic and Trade Commission would also take part, it said.
